questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.B: Digital banking is convenient but requires responsible usage
options.C: Banks are responsible for all online fraud
options.D: Customers should stop using online banking
options.E: Technology has made banking more expensive

questions.directions: Directions Read the passage carefully and answer Q1–5. Digital banking has transformed the way people access financial services. Customers can now transfer money, pay bills and even apply for loans without visiting a branch. However, greater convenience has also created new risks. Fraudsters frequently use misleading messages and fake websites to obtain confidential information. Banks continue to improve their security systems, but customers also have an important role to play. They should avoid clicking on suspicious links, use strong passwords and verify unexpected requests before responding. Thus, technology can make banking more convenient, but responsible behaviour remains essential.
